Questions

Quick answers.

Do I need a website already?

No, we build it. Already have WordPress? Booking setup alone is ₹4,999.

Is the website really mine?

Yes. Your hosting account, your domain. You keep it even if you stop working with us.

What does it cost each year?

Hosting and domain, about ₹3,000. Pro is free for year one. After 6 months of free care, care is ₹999 a month if you want it.

Do clients need an app?

No. They book on your website from any phone, without an app or a login.

What do WhatsApp reminders cost?

They go from your own WhatsApp Business account. Meta charges a small fee per message. Email reminders are free.

What if I don't like the design?

You get 2 rounds of changes before launch.
